snippet.title: Lords of Midnight gameplay (PC Game, 1995)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Lords of Midnight, Dos PC game produced by Maelstrom Games in 1995 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/lords-of-midnight/7842/
Lords of Midnight is a very interesting game, quite complex, medieval. The world of Lords of Midnight is pretty large, and you use a map to range across it and direct your allies.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
